biggest_catch: Two qualifying payroll/government deposits totaling $500+ AND eight debit purchases totaling $100+ within 90 days — and the bonus takes a full 90 days to arrive.
catches: Freedom Blue® Checking: $250 bonus, promo code MSB250, $0 monthly fee. Freedom Gold® and Freedom Platinum®: $350 bonus, promo code MSB350.
Must not have had a personal Middlesex checking account in the past 365 days (individually or jointly); provide the promo code at account opening.
Enroll in e-Statements; make two qualifying payroll or government-issued direct deposits totaling $500 or more within 90 days of opening.
Use the debit card for at least eight purchase transactions within 90 days totaling at least $100 — transactions must post and clear; ATM transactions do not qualify.
Incentive deposited into the checking account 90 days after the account is opened.
Accounts can be opened with a $1 minimum deposit.
Limit one incentive per person and per account; offers expire 12/31/26; may be withdrawn at any time.
Gold Checking: $19 monthly fee waived with $10,000 in combined deposit and portfolio loan balances. Platinum: $29 monthly fee waived with $50,000 in combined balances.
